basic_info.description: Gorgeous luxury condominium in Jackson Square! Tucked away in a boutique building, this wonderful home offers two bedrooms and two bathrooms plus a den with a private patio. The living room features high ceilings, oversized windows, and plenty of room for formal dining. The open kitchen is equipped with an island with breakfast bar, stone countertops, sleek tile backsplash, deluxe Viking Professional appliances, and a pantry closet. A serene, spacious primary bedroom showcases south and east-facing windows and a large walk-in closet, and the luxurious ensuite bath is well-appointed with a double vanity, soaking tub and glass-enclosed shower. Off the great room is an inviting den or office with sliding glass doors out to a covered, wind-protected patio - useable come rain or shine! Down the hall is a lovely guest bedroom which overlooks the patio and boasts a walk-in closet, and an attractive second bathroom with shower over tub. Amenities include wide-plank oak flooring, in-unit laundry, built-in speakers, video intercom, central AC, private storage, a stylish lobby, and 1-car garage parking. Across from the U.S. Custom House and located just a few blocks from incredible North Beach and Financial District restaurants, the Battery, Embarcadero, Bay Club, and Ferry Building.
